name: When should I select my appliances during a kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: When should I select my appliances during a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should finalize your layout and major appliance selections before purchasing cabinets. Cabinet orders depend entirely on exact appliance specifications, including width, depth, door swing clearances, and ventilation requirements. A 36-inch professional range, counter-depth refrigerator, or panel-ready dishwasher requires precise cutouts and cabinet spacing. Changing an appliance model after cabinets are fabricated often leads to expensive delays, fit issues, or reordering cabinet components on the jobsite.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose your appliances before ordering cabinets. Exact appliance dimensions and hookup requirements dictate cabinet sizing and prevent costly jobsite delays.
